motivation: This fallback objective and its implementation predate the first time-20 test summary. The time-20 test is not used to select a weight or checkpoint.

screen.selection_rule: smallest weight passing every frozen validation check

new_holdout.purpose: restore an untouched dataset-level holdout after the original time-20 diagnostic
new_holdout.representatives: fit only on the original time-20 validation split
new_holdout.scoring: new initial conditions never used for training, tuning, representative fitting, or promotion

terminal_rule: If no screen weight or fresh-seed promotion passes, retain the original time-20 test as bounded alignment evidence and do not tune on either test set.
